currentUserGoal: Give a Galaxy S22 Ultra player a compact, efficient APK that runs the complete game offline during travel.
workCompleted: Added a minimal native Android WebView shell for the production title-screen route, with hardware acceleration, immersive display, local save persistence, background timer pausing, and blocked external requests and navigation.
Kept the package offline-only: the final manifest requests zero Android permissions and the APK contains no embedded browser engine or architecture-specific native libraries.

Added a repeatable Android asset pipeline that bundles only the built index and dist/assets contents while excluding social previews, web manifests, favicons, source maps, generated debug output, and private signing material.
Converted the 188-second mono soundtrack from an 8.29 MB PCM WAV to a 1.12 MB Ogg Vorbis file and updated both game scenes to use it.
Added an offline-app-only 60 FPS Phaser cap and an Android 15+ native 60 Hz request to avoid wasting GPU and battery on high-refresh phones without changing the website's pacing.
Added R8 code shrinking, Android resource shrinking, Gradle configuration caching, adaptive/fallback launcher icons, and a stable private alpha signing workflow.
Added npm run android:assets and npm run android:apk plus durable build/install documentation.
Built the signed release artifact at artifacts/android/GrassTouchingSimulator-0.1.0-offline.apk.
verificationRun: npm run check passed after the final changes: ESLint, Knip, 159 Vitest tests across 18 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
npm run android:apk passed with Android Gradle Plugin 8.13.2, Gradle 8.13, JDK 17, compile SDK 36, Build Tools 35.0.0, R8, resource shrinking, lintVital, and release signing.
Final APK size is 3,121,617 bytes (2.98 MiB); SHA-256 is 7df01e2b848bb07390b9e74ccea62b61c6ef27f2cfe93507d4455d771c54f483.
apksigner verifies the APK with an RSA-3072 alpha certificate using APK Signature Scheme v2.
aapt reports minSdk 24, targetSdk 35, and zero requested permissions.
APK inventory contains 95 entries and 64 game assets with zero native libraries, WAV files, source maps, or social/web-discovery extras.

At 384x824, the clean Run 1 mobile layout rendered correctly, accepted the semantic field touch on the first attempt, reported zero frame spikes and full-field scans, and produced no browser warnings or errors.
At 1280x720, Game Over and the first Tiny Sprinkler Memory purchase worked; the Memory controls updated correctly and browser logs remained clean.
knownIssues: No Android device or emulator was connected, so installation, audio output, rotation, suspend/resume, and sustained thermal performance have not yet been exercised on the physical Galaxy S22 Ultra.
The APK intentionally relies on Android System WebView; the friend should install pending Android System WebView updates before travel if the device is behind.
Uninstalling the app removes its local save. Updating with future APKs preserves the save only when they use the same private alpha signing key.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and was not modified.
nextRecommendedSteps: Back up .android-signing securely before distributing or rebuilding the APK.

Install the APK on the Galaxy S22 Ultra and perform a short airplane-mode smoke test covering title screen, music and SFX, rapid touching, Game Over, Memory purchase, next run, rotation, background/resume, and save persistence.
For meaningful mobile performance evidence, connect the S22 Ultra over USB and profile a progressed field rather than treating the 1x1 browser check as proof of late-game thermals.
Push or sync the committed Android source only when requested; the APK and private key must remain outside Git.
doNotRevert: Do not add Android INTERNET or ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions unless online functionality becomes an explicit requirement.
Do not replace the system WebView shell with a bundled browser engine; that would substantially bloat the APK.
Do not restore the WAV soundtrack; the Ogg file preserves the duration at a fraction of the size.
Do not commit android/app/src/main/assets, Android build outputs, the APK, android/local.properties, or .android-signing.
Do not regenerate or lose the private signing key after distribution, because Android would treat future builds as a different signer.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
